entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • It looks like IsEqualEvaluation is missing a type check for indexer evaluations #82398
  • Compiler crashes on local method opted into runtime async #82397
    18.5

Closed

  • Collection-Expression-Cast to non generic type is not recognized as cast but as ParenthesizedExpression #82405
  • Assertion failed: Unrelated assembly in MakeFinalIVTDetermination #82122
    18.4
  • EditorConfig path matching appears case-sensitive on Windows #82380
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11512.234 #82396

PullRequests

Created

  • Use attribute to designate Union types #82408
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Unions
  • Migrate the old workspace logging tool into Roslyn itself #82407
    Area-IDE
  • Pattern matching: Ensure indexer types match when indexer evaluations are checked for equivalence #82406
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Pattern Matching
  • Ensure that IsRuntimeAsyncEnabledIn is propagated for closure symbols #82404
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async
  • Fix ref safety of ref-struct IEnumerable collection expressions #82401
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Ref Fields, Feature - Collection Expressions

Merged

  • PropertySymbol.IsReadOnly/IsWriteOnly: use helpers that compiler uses itself to check for existence of a setter/getter #82390
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Unions: Address/remove some PROTOTYPE comments #82381
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Updates build instructions for all copilot instructions #82402
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Disable processing of source-generated documents in unit testing #82359
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Initial support for non-boxing union TryGetValue access pattern #82325
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Unions
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 2902952 #82373
    Area-IDE, Next

Updated

  • Unsafe evolution: use attribute to denote requires-unsafe members #82383
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Fix `GetDeconstructionInfo` on converted deconstruction assignment #82324
    Area-Compilers
  • Re-enable tiered JIT for 'dotnet build' #82350
    Area-Compilers
  • Not for review #82067
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review
  • Improve error handling when the server hits an unrecoverable error #82376
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Unsafe evolution: avoid checking unreferenced assemblies #82300
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Fix crash in simplify linq expression #82392
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Fix resx source generator for less common resx metadata and locations #81994
    Area-Analyzers, Community
  • Avoid eliding nested pointer-to-ref conversions #82263
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix EditorConfig asymmetric path normalization and document case-sensitivity design #82382
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • File-based apps: csproj-in-cone check #82327
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode
